newsitem.title: USA: Network Long Distance to consider sale.
newsitem.headline: Network Long Distance to consider sale.

text.p: Network Long Distance Inc said it would consider the sale of the company as part of a program to accelerate mergers and acquisitions.

"Yes, the board is committed to do anything it has to do to enhance or maximize shareholder value," said company executive Louis Resweber in a response to a question asked during a telephone conference call.
Resweber, who is chief executive officer of the company's merger and acquisition subsidiary, spoke to members of Wall Street after the company announced it hired investment bank Seruus Ventures LLC.

Resweber said the company has an active list of possible merger candidates and is considering specific transactions. Although the company is close to a definitive pact, he indicated that an announcement was not imminent.
In terms of acquisitions, Resweber said Baton Rouge, La.-based Network Long Distance would likely favor a stock transaction for tax reasons.
He also said the company is considering changing its stock market listing status and its fiscal year, which now ends March 31.
Network Long Distance shares were up one to 8-7/8.
